title: Feedback-Driven Tool-Use Improvements in Large Language Models via Automated Build Environments
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
authors_zh: Junjie Ye, Changhao Jiang, Zhengyin Du, Yufei Xu, Xuesong Yao, Zhiheng Xi, Xiaoran Fan, Qi Zhang, Tao Gui, Xuanjing Huang, Jiecao Chen
paper_type_zh: 可执行工具环境与反馈驱动智能体训练论文
best_for_zh: 研究环境型 agent trajectory、工具反馈、RLVR reward、可执行数据安全与发布审计的读者
one_line: FTRL turns 2,415 synthetic local tool environments into current-policy interaction states scored by executable feedback for GRPO or Reinforce++, while leaving sampled trajectories, data rights, and secure paper-exact replay unresolved.
FTRL 将 2,415 个合成的本地 Python 工具环境转化为带可执行反馈和标量奖励的当前策略交互状态，用于 GRPO 或 Reinforce++；但论文运行轨迹、数据权利与安全可重放包均未公开。
why: It exposes a concrete bridge from environment state and tool observations to scalar agent-training reward, and it also shows why an official code/data release must be audited for trajectory completeness, verifier brittleness, executable-code safety, licensing, and version replay before reuse.
inclusion_reason: FTRL makes the environment-to-feedback boundary unusually concrete: each released task carries tool schemas, executable local functions, hidden subanswers, stateful interaction fields, and deterministic reward code consumed by agent RL. It belongs in the environment/trajectory track as an environment and construction recipe, while the absence of released paper-run trajectories and the substring/exec risks are essential audit findings.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The paper studies how to improve tool-using language models when useful supervision must come from interaction with an executable environment rather than from a static answer alone. Its canonical publication is Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026, DOI 10.18653/v1/2026.findings-acl.109. The directory slug ends in 2025 because arXiv:2508.08791 first appeared on 2025-08-12; this date must not be confused with the formal venue year, 2026.

The released unit is a local tool environment, not a frozen trajectory. Each raw JSONL row begins with one user message and carries serialized JSON tool schemas, row-specific Python implementations, a mapping from tool names to hidden subanswers that remain unsolved, solve_rate, a scenario/source label, the split, and a final reference answer. The paper reports 2,215 training environments and 200 custom in-domain test environments. Those counts describe environment/task definitions. They are not counts of sampled training episodes, complete command-observation histories, or retained trajectory files.

At sampling time, a Qwen2.5 or Qwen3 policy extends the initial row into a stateful messages history. Tool calls execute local Python functions, returned text or error strings become observations, and deterministic checks update unsolved_set and solve_rate. The sampler saves the initial state and the state after each tool-calling response. It stops when the policy produces a no-tool response or reaches 20 turns by default, but the terminal no-tool response itself is not appended to the saved output. The official repository does not contain the paper-run generated trajectory corpus.

This object belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the environment defines observable state, tool actions, text observations, progress updates, termination, and scalar feedback consumed by agent RL. It is not evidence for a general process-supervision corpus: the so-called step-level signal is a response/state reward derived from tool outcomes and string matching, not a semantic correctness label for each reasoning step.

The paper and audited repository support L4-depth description of the environment rows, five-stage construction concept, sampler, verifier, reward, optimizer scaffold, evaluation, and failure boundaries. Canonical metadata remains L3_summary_ready and partial: the release omits the paper-run trajectories, end-to-end five-stage construction scripts, exact checkpoints and checkpoint-to-result mapping, immutable paper tag, complete replay environment, explicit data license, and broader contamination audit.

论文研究的是：当有效监督必须来自可执行环境交互，而不是仅来自静态答案时，如何改进具备工具使用能力的语言模型。其正式发表记录为 Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026，DOI 为 10.18653/v1/2026.findings-acl.109。目录 slug 以 2025 结尾，是因为 arXiv:2508.08791 首次提交于 2025 年 8 月 12 日；这一日期不能与正式 venue 年份 2026 混淆。

公开数据的基本单位是本地工具 environment，而不是冻结的 trajectory。每条 raw JSONL row 以一条 user message 开始，并携带序列化的 JSON tool schema、逐条定制的 Python implementation、tool name 到尚未解决的隐藏 subanswer 的映射、solve_rate、scenario/source label、split 与最终 reference answer。论文报告 2,215 个 train environment 和 200 个自建 in-domain test environment。这些数字是 environment/task definition 的数量，不是采样 training episode、完整 command-observation history 或保留 trajectory file 的数量。

采样时，Qwen2.5 或 Qwen3 policy 把初始 row 扩展为有状态的 messages history。tool call 执行本地 Python function，返回的文本或 error string 成为 observation，deterministic check 更新 unsolved_set 与 solve_rate。sampler 保存 initial state 以及每次 tool-calling response 之后的 state。默认在 policy 生成 no-tool response 或达到 20 turn 时停止，但 terminal no-tool response 本身不会追加到保存结果。official repository 不包含论文运行时生成的 trajectory corpus。

该对象归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为 environment 定义了可观察 state、tool action、text observation、progress update、termination 与供 agent RL 使用的 scalar feedback。它并不构成通用 process-supervision corpus 的证据：论文所称 step-level signal 是依据 tool outcome 与字符串匹配得到的 response/state reward，而不是对每个 reasoning step 的 semantic correctness label。

论文与审计过的 repository 足以按 L4 深度说明 environment row、五阶段构造概念、sampler、verifier、reward、optimizer scaffold、evaluation 与 failure boundary。canonical metadata 仍保持 L3_summary_ready 和 partial：公开内容缺少 paper-run trajectory、端到端五阶段 construction script、准确 checkpoint 与 checkpoint-to-result mapping、不可变 paper tag、完整 replay environment、明确 data license，以及更广泛的 contamination audit。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
FTRL's central contribution is to synthesize row-specific, locally executable tool environments and convert current-policy interactions with them into deterministic environment feedback for GRPO or Reinforce++.

The mechanism has two connected objects. The released environment row contains the task prompt, final answer, decomposed hidden subanswers, tool documents, Python implementations, and progress fields. The generated interaction state contains the growing messages history, assistant tool calls, tool observations, the updated unresolved-subanswer set and solve rate, and a scalar reward attached to the last valid response token. Only the first object is released as raw train/test data; the second is produced by Code/data_sample/data_sample.py, and the paper-run outputs are absent from the repository.

The feedback contract is programmatic and environmental. For each tool-calling response with p calls and q newly solved subquestions, the reward is 2q/(p+1). A blank response receives -0.5; malformed tool markup receives -0.3; a response containing the final reference answer receives 1/(1+t) when t subquestions remain; a no-tool response after all subquestions are solved receives 0.5; other responses receive 0. The reward manager writes the resulting scalar on the final valid response token. This is state/action-level scalar supervision, not a released sequence of semantic step labels.

The verifier can observe whether a local function executed, what text or error it returned, whether an expected subanswer occurs as a case-folded substring, how many subquestions remain, and whether final-answer text contains the reference. It cannot establish semantic equivalence, factual truth outside the synthesized function, causal necessity of a tool call, safety of the code, or correctness of unobserved internal rationale. Substring containment can reward leaked/colliding strings and reject equivalent answers with different formatting.

The closest comparison surfaces in the paper are tool-use evaluation suites such as ToolHop, tau-bench, and RoTBench and the two optimizer choices, GRPO and Reinforce++. FTRL uses the former for out-of-domain evaluation and adopts the latter as training scaffolds. Its differentiating element is not a new optimizer or semantic judge, but the integration of a five-stage synthetic local-environment construction process with stateful progress tracking and an efficiency/completion reward.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is the explicit bridge from environment definition to sampled state, tool observation, verifier update, and policy reward. The same bridge also reveals the audit boundary: executable consistency and benchmark improvement do not by themselves establish trajectory completeness, data quality, safety, or rights for reuse.

FTRL 的核心贡献是合成逐条定制、可在本地执行的 tool environment，并把 current-policy 与这些 environment 的交互转化为供 GRPO 或 Reinforce++ 使用的 deterministic environment feedback。

该机制连接两类对象。公开的 environment row 包含 task prompt、final answer、分解后的隐藏 subanswer、tool document、Python implementation 与 progress field。生成的 interaction state 包含持续增长的 messages history、assistant tool call、tool observation、更新后的未解决 subanswer 集合与 solve rate，以及附着在最后一个有效 response token 上的 scalar reward。公开 raw train/test data 只有第一类对象；第二类对象由 Code/data_sample/data_sample.py 产生，论文运行时的输出没有进入 repository。

feedback contract 同时是 programmatic 与 environmental 的。对于含 p 次 tool call、并新解决 q 个 subquestion 的 response，reward 为 2q/(p+1)。blank response 得 -0.5，malformed tool markup 得 -0.3；当仍有 t 个 subquestion 时，包含最终 reference answer 的 response 得 1/(1+t)；全部 subquestion 已解决后的 no-tool response 得 0.5；其他 response 得 0。reward manager 把该 scalar 写到最后一个有效 response token。这是 state/action-level scalar supervision，不是公开的 semantic step-label sequence。

verifier 能观察本地 function 是否执行、返回了什么 text 或 error、预期 subanswer 是否以忽略大小写的 substring 出现、还剩多少 subquestion，以及 final-answer text 是否包含 reference。它不能确认 semantic equivalence、合成 function 之外的 factual truth、某个 tool call 是否因果必要、代码是否安全，或隐藏 reasoning 是否正确。substring containment 既可能奖励泄露或碰撞的字符串，也可能拒绝格式不同但语义等价的答案。

论文中最接近的比较面包括 ToolHop、tau-bench、RoTBench 等 tool-use evaluation suite，以及 GRPO 与 Reinforce++ 两种 optimizer。FTRL 用前者做 out-of-domain evaluation，并采用后者作为 training scaffold。其差异点不是新的 optimizer 或 semantic judge，而是把五阶段 synthetic local-environment construction、stateful progress tracking 与兼顾效率和完成度的 reward 结合起来。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是从 environment definition 到 sampled state、tool observation、verifier update 和 policy reward 的显式连接。同一连接也揭示了审计边界：executable consistency 与 benchmark improvement 本身不能证明 trajectory 完整、data quality、安全或复用权利。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and environment construction. The authors manually create user questions, final answers, and decomposed subquestions for four structures: single-hop, parallel single-hop, multi-hop, and parallel multi-hop. GPT-4o assists a five-stage process: scenario decomposition, tool-document generation, function integration, complexity scaling, and localized deployment. For construction, the paper reports temperature 0 and max_tokens=2048. The result is a row-specific set of JSON tool descriptions and Python implementations plus hidden subanswers and progress fields. The underlying fact sources, item identifiers, annotator/adjudication protocol, and source rights are not disclosed. Appendix D publishes prompts, but the audited repository has no end-to-end program implementing all five stages or preserving intermediate GPT-4o outputs and review logs.

Released objects and splits. Data/jsonl/raw/train.jsonl contains the reported 2,215 training environments: 500 single-hop, 500 parallel single-hop, 500 multi-hop, and 715 parallel multi-hop. The custom test.jsonl contains 200 environments, 50 per scenario. A row exposes messages, tools, codes, unsolved_set, solve_rate, data_source, split, and answer; several nested objects are JSON serialized inside strings. The authors state that the custom test set does not overlap training, but no item-level provenance manifest, deduplication program, or broader benchmark/pretraining contamination audit is released.

Sampling and interaction. The current Qwen2.5 or Qwen3 policy receives the accumulated message history and row-specific tool schemas. When it emits tool calls, data_sample.py resolves the named Python code, executes it locally, appends each returned value or error string with its tool_call_id, updates unsolved_set and solve_rate, and saves the resulting history state. The repository README's sampling recipe uses temperature 1.0 and at most 20 turns. The sampler saves the initial state and every tool-calling state even when a call fails or solves nothing; it exits on a no-tool response without saving that terminal response. Total sampled, successful, failed, retained, and dropped episode counts are unknown, and no paper-run trajectory files are released.

Verifier, reward, and terminal behavior. answer_verify lowercases, removes commas, strips whitespace, and tests whether the expected string is contained in the observation. Tool-calling reward is 2q/(p+1). Non-tool branches assign -0.5 to blank output, -0.3 to malformed tool markup, 1/(1+t) to an output containing the final answer, 0.5 after all subquestions are solved, and 0 otherwise. The scalar is placed on the last valid response token. Environment completeness is t=0; final-answer validity is checked separately by containment. Sampling termination—no tool call or the default 20-turn limit—is not identical to successful task completion.

Training and evaluation. The trained bases are Qwen2.5-7B/14B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B/14B in non-reasoning and reasoning modes. The paper uses VeRL, GRPO or Reinforce++, learning rate 1e-6, train batch size 512, mini-batch size 32, 16 rollouts per update, KL coefficient 0.001, entropy coefficient 0.001, three epochs with fresh trajectory resampling, and eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The released shell scripts set one epoch per invocation, so the paper's three-epoch orchestration is not fully captured by one immutable config. Qwen 32B/72B variants are evaluation-only and must not be listed as trained bases. Evaluation covers the 200-item custom test set, ToolHop, tau-bench, RoTBench, and six general-capability benchmarks.

Reproduction boundary. A responsible replay must pin repository commit 7022ef0529bbff4901084f17e452eb49cad5fffc, exact model checkpoints, paper-era VeRL revision, Python/CUDA/driver/dependency versions, seeds, decoding settings, timeouts, and per-epoch state manifests. Row-provided Python must run in a disposable sandbox with restricted filesystem, network, subprocess, CPU, memory, and time; the implementation's in-process unrestricted exec plus a ten-second timeout is not a sandbox. No official trained checkpoint release or checkpoint-to-table map was verified.

输入与 environment construction。 作者为 single-hop、parallel single-hop、multi-hop 和 parallel multi-hop 四种结构人工创建 user question、final answer 与分解后的 subquestion。GPT-4o 辅助五阶段流程：scenario decomposition、tool-document generation、function integration、complexity scaling 与 localized deployment。论文报告 construction 使用 temperature 0、max_tokens=2048。输出是逐条定制的 JSON tool description、Python implementation、隐藏 subanswer 与 progress field。底层 fact source、item identifier、annotator/adjudication protocol 和 source right 均未披露。Appendix D 提供 prompt，但经审计的 repository 没有实现全部五阶段的端到端程序，也没有保留中间 GPT-4o output 与 review log。

公开对象与 split。 Data/jsonl/raw/train.jsonl 包含论文报告的 2,215 个 train environment：500 个 single-hop、500 个 parallel single-hop、500 个 multi-hop 与 715 个 parallel multi-hop。自建 test.jsonl 含 200 个 environment，每种 scenario 50 个。row 暴露 messages、tools、codes、unsolved_set、solve_rate、data_source、split 与 answer；其中多个嵌套对象以 JSON string 形式保存。作者声明自建 test set 与 training 不重叠，但没有公开 item-level provenance manifest、deduplication program 或更广泛的 benchmark/pretraining contamination audit。

采样与交互。 当前 Qwen2.5 或 Qwen3 policy 接收累积 message history 与逐条 tool schema。它发出 tool call 后，data_sample.py 找到对应 Python code，在本地执行，按 tool_call_id 追加每个返回值或 error string，更新 unsolved_set 和 solve_rate，再保存形成的 history state。repository README 的 sampling recipe 使用 temperature 1.0，最多 20 turn。sampler 保存 initial state 与每个 tool-calling state，即使 call 失败或没有解决任何 subquestion；遇到 no-tool response 时直接退出，不保存该 terminal response。采样总量、成功/失败量、保留/丢弃 episode 数均为 unknown，paper-run trajectory file 也未公开。

Verifier、reward 与 terminal behavior。 answer_verify 会转为小写、删除逗号、去除首尾空白，再检查 expected string 是否包含于 observation。tool-calling reward 为 2q/(p+1)。non-tool branch 对 blank output 给 -0.5，malformed tool markup 给 -0.3，包含 final answer 的 output 给 1/(1+t)，全部 subquestion 解决后给 0.5，其他情况给 0。scalar 附着在最后一个有效 response token。environment completeness 是 t=0；final-answer validity 另以 containment 检查。sampling termination——无 tool call 或达到默认 20-turn limit——不等同于 task success。

训练与 evaluation。 训练的 base 包括 Qwen2.5-7B/14B-Instruct，以及 Qwen3-8B/14B 的 non-reasoning 和 reasoning mode。论文使用 VeRL、GRPO 或 Reinforce++，learning rate 1e-6、train batch size 512、mini-batch size 32、每次 update 16 个 rollout、KL coefficient 0.001、entropy coefficient 0.001，以 8 张 NVIDIA A100 训练 3 个 epoch，并在每个 epoch 重新采样 trajectory。公开 shell script 每次 invocation 设置为 1 个 epoch，因此论文的三阶段 orchestration 没有由单个 immutable config 完整表达。Qwen 32B/72B variant 只用于 evaluation，不能列为训练 base。evaluation 覆盖 200-item custom test set、ToolHop、tau-bench、RoTBench 和 6 个 general-capability benchmark。

复现边界。 可靠 replay 需要固定 repository commit 7022ef0529bbff4901084f17e452eb49cad5fffc、准确 model checkpoint、paper-era VeRL revision、Python/CUDA/driver/dependency version、seed、decoding setting、timeout 与逐 epoch state manifest。row 提供的 Python 必须放在限制 filesystem、network、subprocess、CPU、memory 与 time 的 disposable sandbox 中运行；当前实现的 in-process unrestricted exec 加 10 秒 timeout 不是 sandbox。没有核验到 official trained checkpoint release 或 checkpoint-to-table map。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest release evidence is structural rather than a model score. At audited commit 7022ef0529bbff4901084f17e452eb49cad5fffc, the official repository contains raw train/test environment JSONL, a stateful trajectory sampler, the substring verifier and deterministic reward implementation, six Qwen2.5/Qwen3 GRPO/Reinforce++ scripts, and evaluation data/code. The 200-row custom test file was parsed as 50 instances for each of the four scenario structures. The much larger train file matches the released row schema, while the paper's Table 1 reports 2,215 train environments split 500/500/500/715. This verifies the task/environment release shape, not the existence of 2,215 complete trajectories.

The paper's Table 2 reports that every displayed trained 7B/14B variant improves its overall tool-use average over the corresponding base. One concrete condition is Qwen3-8B in non-reasoning mode trained with GRPO: 45.43 overall versus 31.01 for the base model. The comparison spans the custom in-domain test surface and the reported external tool-use evaluations under the authors' setup. It supports a policy-performance claim for this environment/reward recipe; it is not evidence that the released rows are correctly licensed, uncontaminated, semantically verified, or sufficient to replay the paper.

The reward ablation gives a more diagnostic result. The authors report that a precision-only objective leaves tasks incomplete, whereas a completion-only objective encourages excessive tool use; their combined reward yields a better balance between tool-call precision and completion (Section 6, Figure 4). This directly motivates the 2q/(p+1) structure, which rewards newly solved subquestions while penalizing extra calls through the denominator. It also documents a reward-gaming mode: a completion signal alone can change call frequency without improving disciplined tool selection.

For general capabilities, the authors report no degradation across six public benchmarks (Table 4 and Figure 3). That claim is author-reported and was not independently reproduced for this Card. It should be read only within those tested models, checkpoints, metrics, and budgets; it does not establish broad preservation of reasoning, safety, or factuality.

Negative and boundary evidence matters. The paper's limitations state that the method improves tool invocation more than underlying reasoning and that current reasoning patterns remain poorly aligned with tool use. The repository further shows that a reward can be positive through final-answer substring containment without proving semantic correctness, and the sampler does not retain the terminal no-tool response. No generated trajectory corpus, exact trained checkpoints, or immutable run manifest is available for independent recoding of successes, failures, or paper-table results.

最强的 release evidence 来自结构，而不是 model score。在审计的 commit 7022ef0529bbff4901084f17e452eb49cad5fffc 上，official repository 包含 raw train/test environment JSONL、有状态 trajectory sampler、substring verifier 与 deterministic reward implementation、6 个 Qwen2.5/Qwen3 GRPO/Reinforce++ script，以及 evaluation data/code。200-row custom test file 经解析后确认四种 scenario structure 各 50 条。更大的 train file 与公开 row schema 一致，而论文 Table 1 报告 2,215 个 train environment，分布为 500/500/500/715。这核验了 task/environment release shape，并不证明存在 2,215 条完整 trajectory。

论文 Table 2 报告：所有展示的 7B/14B 训练 variant 的 overall tool-use average 都高于对应 base。一个具体条件是 Qwen3-8B non-reasoning mode 使用 GRPO 训练后为 45.43 overall，而 base model 为 31.01。该比较覆盖作者设置下的 custom in-domain test surface 与所报告的 external tool-use evaluation。它支持这套 environment/reward recipe 的 policy-performance claim；不能据此证明公开 row 已正确授权、无 contamination、经 semantic verification，或足以重放论文结果。

reward ablation 提供了更具诊断性的结果。作者报告，precision-only objective 会使 task 保持未完成，而 completion-only objective 会鼓励过量 tool use；组合 reward 在 tool-call precision 与 completion 之间取得更好平衡（Section 6，Figure 4）。这直接解释了 2q/(p+1) 的设计：奖励新解决的 subquestion，同时通过分母惩罚额外 call。它也记录了一种 reward-gaming mode：单独使用 completion signal 可能改变调用频率，却不一定改善有约束的 tool selection。

关于 general capability，作者报告在 6 个 public benchmark 上没有退化（Table 4 与 Figure 3）。这是 author-reported claim，本 Card 没有独立复现。只能在论文测试的 model、checkpoint、metric 与 budget 范围内理解，不能外推为广泛保持 reasoning、safety 或 factuality。

negative 与 boundary evidence 同样重要。论文 limitations 指出，该方法对 tool invocation 的改善大于对底层 reasoning 的改善，现有 reasoning pattern 与 tool use 仍缺乏良好对齐。repository 还显示，final-answer substring containment 可能在没有证明 semantic correctness 时给出正 reward，而 sampler 不保留 terminal no-tool response。没有生成 trajectory corpus、准确 trained checkpoint 或 immutable run manifest，可供独立重编码 success、failure 或 paper-table result。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is not an absence of tool-use training. FTRL builds on established tool-calling models, locally executable functions, current-policy rollout, GRPO, Reinforce++, and tool-use benchmarks. Programmatic rewards and multi-turn environment interaction are therefore components to audit, not grounds for an unsupported “first” claim.

What changes is the construction-to-training interface. A manually authored question/answer is decomposed into scenario-specific hidden subanswers; GPT-4o helps synthesize tool documents and Python implementations; a policy interacts with those row-specific functions; observations deterministically remove solved subanswers; and an efficiency/completion scalar is attached to the sampled response for policy optimization. The data object is thus neither a static answer nor a complete released episode, but an executable task definition plus transient state/history prefixes generated from the current policy.

The feedback interface is unusually inspectable. The verifier's observable is returned text, its progress state is the remaining-subanswer mapping, and its tool-call reward is 2q/(p+1). This makes the link between action, observation, state update, and scalar reward explicit enough to audit. It also makes the weakness explicit: the verifier detects substring-bearing progress rather than semantic task completion, and in-process Python execution expands the trust boundary to every released row.

The five-stage scenario/document/function/scaling/deployment recipe is the methodological contribution described by the paper, but the release provides prompts and completed raw rows rather than the end-to-end construction program, intermediate generations, or human review record. Similarly, using VeRL, GRPO, Reinforce++, Qwen models, or temperature-based sampling is inherited scaffolding; the current repository's later state and one-epoch scripts are release engineering, not evidence of a new learning algorithm.

For environment_agent_trajectory_data, the direction signal is to publish executable environment definitions together with explicit progress state and reward code, while distinguishing those definitions from sampled trajectories. Quality signals are concrete schema, code-level verifier behavior, retained error observations, and ablations that reveal reward tradeoffs—not the best benchmark score. Before reuse, researchers must still verify semantic calibration, adversarial substring behavior, sandboxing, five-stage lineage, full trajectory retention including terminal outputs, split/contamination controls, immutable versions, licenses, and checkpoint-to-result replay.

prior baseline 并不是不存在 tool-use training。FTRL 建立在已有的 tool-calling model、locally executable function、current-policy rollout、GRPO、Reinforce++ 与 tool-use benchmark 之上。因此，programmatic reward 和 multi-turn environment interaction 是需要审计的组成部分，不能据此提出无证据的“首次”主张。

真正改变的是 construction-to-training interface。人工编写的 question/answer 被分解为面向特定 scenario 的隐藏 subanswer；GPT-4o 辅助合成 tool document 与 Python implementation；policy 与逐条定制的 function 交互；observation 以 deterministic 规则移除已解决 subanswer；最后把兼顾效率与完成度的 scalar 附着到 sampled response，用于 policy optimization。因此，data object 既不是静态 answer，也不是完整公开 episode，而是 executable task definition 加上 current policy 生成的临时 state/history prefix。

feedback interface 具有较高可检查性。verifier 的 observable 是返回文本，progress state 是 remaining-subanswer mapping，tool-call reward 是 2q/(p+1)。因此 action、observation、state update 与 scalar reward 的连接足够明确，可以审计。其弱点也同样明确：verifier 检测的是携带目标 substring 的 progress，不是 semantic task completion；in-process Python execution 则把 trust boundary 扩展到每条公开 row。

论文描述的五阶段 scenario/document/function/scaling/deployment recipe 是方法贡献，但 release 只提供 prompt 与完成后的 raw row，没有端到端 construction program、中间 generation 或 human review record。同样，使用 VeRL、GRPO、Reinforce++、Qwen model 或 temperature-based sampling 属于继承的 scaffold；当前 repository 的后续状态和 one-epoch script 属于 release engineering，不是新 learning algorithm 的证据。

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，方向信号是同时公开 executable environment definition、显式 progress state 与 reward code，并把这些 definition 与 sampled trajectory 严格区分。quality signal 来自具体 schema、code-level verifier behavior、保留的 error observation，以及揭示 reward tradeoff 的 ablation，而不是最佳 benchmark score。复用前仍需核验 semantic calibration、adversarial substring behavior、sandbox、五阶段 lineage、包含 terminal output 的完整 trajectory retention、split/contamination control、immutable version、license 与 checkpoint-to-result replay。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The released count is not a trajectory count. The 2,215 train and 200 test items are executable environment definitions. Generated paper-run histories, per-epoch manifests, total rollouts, success/failure/error counts, terminal answers, and dropped-state counts are unavailable. The sampler retains initial and tool-calling states, including failed calls, but drops the terminal no-tool response; this prevents a complete public episode record.
  • The verifier is text-brittle. After limited normalization, answer_verify uses substring containment. Expected text leaked into a verbose observation or colliding with another string can create a false positive. Semantically equivalent aliases, number/date formats, or structured outputs can create false negatives. The paper does not report calibration rates, adversarial tests, or a semantic adjudicator. A positive reward establishes agreement with this string contract, not correctness of reasoning or real-world facts.
  • The reward can be gamed. The paper itself shows that completion-only feedback encourages tool overuse. The final-answer containment branch can also grant positive reward without requiring every intended tool step to be completed. Coarse penalties conflate malformed markup, parser failure, missing functions, timeouts, environment exceptions, and policy reasoning failures, complicating diagnosis.
  • Execution is unsafe without an external sandbox. call_function executes row-provided Python through unrestricted in-process exec. A ten-second timeout does not restrict filesystem, network, subprocess, imports, persistence, secrets, CPU, or memory. Running untrusted or modified rows on a normal training host can execute arbitrary code; isolation and least privilege are requirements, not optional optimizations.
  • Synthetic consistency can diverge from reality. GPT-4o-generated functions may encode stale, incomplete, or incorrect facts. Successful execution plus substring agreement only demonstrates internal consistency of the local environment. It does not establish that the tool is faithful to a real API, that the observation is factually correct, or that the call was causally useful.
  • Construction lineage is incomplete. Appendix D supplies prompts for the five-stage process, but the repository does not include the end-to-end construction scripts, intermediate GPT-4o generations, source-fact identifiers, human review/adjudication logs, or item-level provenance. Exact sources, annotators, fact-checking, privacy, consent, and rights for manually authored questions and embedded facts are unknown.
  • Replay and release versioning are incomplete. The final publication is ACL 2026 while the slug reflects the 2025 arXiv debut. Repository main was audited at 7022ef..., but the paper pins no commit; there are no tags or GitHub releases. Exact checkpoints, seeds, complete decoding settings, paper-era VeRL revision, Python/CUDA/driver/container pins, and checkpoint-to-table mapping are unavailable. Released scripts set one epoch per invocation while the paper reports three resampled epochs.
  • Licensing and contamination remain unresolved. Apache-2.0 is explicitly stated for code, not clearly for raw data, embedded implementations/facts, manually created inputs, or bundled upstream benchmark assets. Only custom train/test non-overlap is asserted; item-level evidence, broader deduplication, public-benchmark overlap, pretraining contamination, and privacy/consent audits are unknown.
  • Experimental scope is limited. Reported gains concern the tested Qwen configurations and tool-use evaluation surfaces. Qwen 32B/72B variants are evaluation-only. The authors acknowledge greater improvement in tool invocation than underlying reasoning. Benchmark improvement is not proof of environment quality, verifier validity, safe data reuse, or general reasoning improvement.

• 公开数量不是 trajectory 数量。 2,215 个 train item 与 200 个 test item 是 executable environment definition。paper-run history、逐 epoch manifest、总 rollout 数、success/failure/error 计数、terminal answer 与 dropped-state 数均未公开。sampler 保留 initial state 与 tool-calling state，包括失败 call，却丢弃 terminal no-tool response，因此公开记录不能构成完整 episode。
  • Verifier 对文本形式敏感。 answer_verify 仅做有限 normalization 后使用 substring containment。预期文本泄露在冗长 observation 中或与其他字符串碰撞，可能产生 false positive；语义等价的 alias、数字/日期格式或 structured output 可能产生 false negative。论文没有报告 calibration rate、adversarial test 或 semantic adjudicator。正 reward 只能证明符合该 string contract，不能证明 reasoning 或现实事实正确。
  • Reward 可能被 gaming。 论文自身显示，completion-only feedback 会鼓励 tool overuse。final-answer containment branch 也可能在没有完成全部预期 tool step 时给出正 reward。粗粒度 penalty 混合了 malformed markup、parser failure、missing function、timeout、environment exception 与 policy reasoning failure，使诊断更困难。
  • 没有外部 sandbox 时执行不安全。 call_function 通过 unrestricted in-process exec 执行 row 提供的 Python。10 秒 timeout 不限制 filesystem、network、subprocess、import、persistence、secret、CPU 或 memory。在普通 training host 上运行不可信或被修改的 row，可能执行任意代码；隔离与 least privilege 是必需条件，不是可选优化。
  • Synthetic consistency 可能偏离现实。 GPT-4o 生成的 function 可能编码陈旧、不完整或错误事实。成功执行加 substring agreement 只说明 local environment 内部一致，不能证明 tool 忠实于真实 API、observation 符合事实，或该 call 具有因果上的用途。
  • Construction lineage 不完整。 Appendix D 提供五阶段流程的 prompt，但 repository 没有端到端 construction script、中间 GPT-4o generation、source-fact identifier、human review/adjudication log 或 item-level provenance。人工 question 与 embedded fact 的准确来源、annotator、fact-checking、privacy、consent 与权利均为 unknown。
  • Replay 与 release versioning 不完整。 正式 publication 是 ACL 2026，而 slug 反映 2025 年 arXiv 首发。repository main 审计于 7022ef...，但论文没有 pin commit；也没有 tag 或 GitHub release。准确 checkpoint、seed、完整 decoding setting、paper-era VeRL revision、Python/CUDA/driver/container pin 与 checkpoint-to-table mapping 均缺失。公开 script 每次 invocation 设置为 1 个 epoch，而论文报告 3 个重新采样 epoch。
  • License 与 contamination 未解决。 Apache-2.0 明确适用于 code，但没有明确覆盖 raw data、embedded implementation/fact、人工 input 或 bundled upstream benchmark asset。只声明 custom train/test 不重叠；item-level evidence、更广泛 deduplication、public-benchmark overlap、pretraining contamination 与 privacy/consent audit 均为 unknown。
  • 实验范围有限。 结果只覆盖测试的 Qwen configuration 与 tool-use evaluation surface。Qwen 32B/72B variant 仅用于 evaluation。作者承认 tool invocation 的改善大于 underlying reasoning。benchmark improvement 不能证明 environment quality、verifier validity、安全 data reuse 或一般 reasoning improvement。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, FTRL is most useful as an environment/reward construction recipe and an evaluation/audit reference. It demonstrates a concrete record boundary: publish a task row with prompt, tool schema, executable implementation, hidden progress targets, split, and final answer; then separately represent each policy-generated state with action, observation, progress delta, scalar reward, termination reason, and run provenance. The current release implements the first layer and the state generator, but does not publish the paper-run second layer.

Environment builders can reuse the mechanism as a design baseline after replacing the unsafe execution and brittle verifier. A stronger implementation would run row code in immutable, disposable, non-networked sandboxes; declare filesystem/subprocess/resource policies; parse typed tool results; use task-specific semantic or structural checks; record false-positive/false-negative calibration; and preserve every initial, intermediate, error, success, timeout, and terminal state. This turns the FTRL audit findings into an executable environment-data checklist.

Reward researchers can reproduce the precision/completion tradeoff with controlled variants of 2q/(p+1), completion-only reward, precision-only reward, final-answer reward, and explicit penalties for malformed calls. Required measurements include tool-call count, subquestion coverage, early final-answer shortcuts, substring collisions, malformed-call rate, environment exceptions, and reward-versus-semantic-success disagreement. Such studies should keep model, environment version, decoding budget, and rollout count fixed.

Agent-training researchers can use the disclosed pipeline as an implementation reference for current-policy GRPO/Reinforce++ over local tools, but direct training reuse of the released rows is blocked. Before execution or training, they need an explicit data license and source-rights manifest, sandboxed code, immutable row checksums, exact model and VeRL revisions, three-epoch orchestration, seeds, per-epoch trajectory manifests, terminal-output retention, and contamination checks. The paper supports only rlvr, agent_training, and evaluation; it does not support reclassifying these rows as SFT demonstrations, preference pairs, reward-model examples, or process-reward labels.

The appropriate reuse class is recipe and evaluation reference; training reuse blocked pending verification. The 200 custom test environments and bundled ToolHop, tau-bench, and RoTBench assets can inform evaluation reconstruction only after upstream versions, rights, overlap, and execution safety are checked. Benchmark scores should be reported as system evidence under this feedback contract, never as proof that the underlying data are complete or high quality.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，FTRL 最适合作为 environment/reward construction recipe 以及 evaluation/audit reference。它展示了明确的记录边界：先公开带 prompt、tool schema、executable implementation、hidden progress target、split 与 final answer 的 task row；再把每个 policy-generated state 单独表示为 action、observation、progress delta、scalar reward、termination reason 与 run provenance。当前 release 实现了第一层和 state generator，但没有公开论文运行时的第二层数据。

environment builder 可以在替换不安全执行与脆弱 verifier 后，把该机制作为设计 baseline。更强的实现应在 immutable、disposable、non-networked sandbox 中运行 row code；声明 filesystem/subprocess/resource policy；解析 typed tool result；使用面向任务的 semantic 或 structural check；记录 false-positive/false-negative calibration；并保留全部 initial、intermediate、error、success、timeout 与 terminal state。这样可把 FTRL 的 audit finding 转化为可执行的 environment-data checklist。

reward 研究者可以对 2q/(p+1)、completion-only reward、precision-only reward、final-answer reward 与 malformed-call explicit penalty 做 controlled variant，复现 precision/completion tradeoff。需要测量 tool-call count、subquestion coverage、early final-answer shortcut、substring collision、malformed-call rate、environment exception，以及 reward 与 semantic success 的分歧。这类实验应固定 model、environment version、decoding budget 与 rollout count。

agent-training 研究者可把公开 pipeline 用作基于 local tool 的 current-policy GRPO/Reinforce++ implementation reference，但直接复用公开 row 进行训练仍处于 blocked 状态。执行或训练前，需要明确 data license 与 source-rights manifest、sandboxed code、immutable row checksum、准确 model 与 VeRL revision、三 epoch orchestration、seed、逐 epoch trajectory manifest、terminal-output retention 与 contamination check。论文只支持 rlvr、agent_training 与 evaluation；不支持把 row 改称为 SFT demonstration、preference pair、reward-model example 或 process-reward label。

合适的复用等级是recipe 与 evaluation reference；training reuse 在完成核验前 blocked。200 个 custom test environment，以及 bundled ToolHop、tau-bench、RoTBench asset，只有在核对 upstream version、权利、overlap 与 execution safety 后才可用于重建 evaluation。benchmark score 应作为这套 feedback contract 下的 system evidence 报告，不能作为底层 data 完整或高质量的证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the dates separate: the slug records the 2025 arXiv debut, while the canonical paper is Findings of ACL 2026 with DOI 10.18653/v1/2026.findings-acl.109.
  • Start from the released object: 2,215 train plus 200 custom test items are local executable environment definitions, not a complete trajectory corpus. The sampler generates history states, but the paper-run files are absent and the terminal no-tool response is not saved.
  • Read Sections 3.1–3.2 and Figure 2 for the five-stage environment and reward pipeline, Table 1 for scenario counts, Table 2 for trained/base comparisons, Figure 4 for reward ablation, Appendix D for construction prompts, and the repository sampler/verifier/reward files for implementation behavior.
  • Keep the feedback contract exact: tool outputs and final answers are checked by normalized substring containment; 2q/(p+1) is a response-level tool-call reward placed on the last token, not semantic process labels. Unrestricted Python exec is the most immediate reuse risk.
  • Pair this Card with environment-agent work that releases full episodes or stronger terminal verifiers, and audit five-stage scripts, generated trajectories, checkpoints, replay pins, licenses, contamination, semantic calibration, and sandboxing before any training reuse. Benchmark gains do not settle these questions.

• 必须区分日期：slug 记录 2025 年 arXiv 首发，canonical paper 则是 Findings of ACL 2026，DOI 为 10.18653/v1/2026.findings-acl.109。

  • 阅读顺序：Sections 3.1–3.2 与 Figure 2 看五阶段 environment/reward pipeline，Table 1 看 scenario count，Table 2 看 trained/base comparison，Figure 4 看 reward ablation，Appendix D 看 construction prompt，再结合 repository 的 sampler/verifier/reward file 检查 implementation behavior。
  • feedback contract 必须保持准确：tool output 与 final answer 都以 normalization 后的 substring containment 检查；2q/(p+1) 是附着在最后一个 token 的 response-level tool-call reward，不是 semantic process label。unrestricted Python exec 是最直接的复用风险。
  • 可将本 Card 与公开完整 episode 或更强 terminal verifier 的 environment-agent 工作对读；任何 training reuse 前都要审计五阶段 script、generated trajectory、checkpoint、replay pin、license、contamination、semantic calibration 与 sandbox。benchmark gain 不能回答这些问题。

value.html: Authors manually construct user inputs for four scenario families: single-hop, parallel single-hop, multi-hop, and parallel multi-hop. GPT-4o assists construction of tool documents, integration, complexity scaling, and code. The underlying fact/source corpus, annotator protocol, and item-level provenance are unknown.

A locally executed Python function returns text, JSON stringification, or an error message. The observation is appended to messages and checked against expected subanswers by case-folded substring containment.

Assistant responses use the selected model family's tool-call syntax and eventually produce a natural- language final answer. Tool observations are text strings tied to tool_call_id; failures are serialized as error text.
The current Qwen2.5 or Qwen3 policy samples multi-turn tool-call histories inside each local environment. GPT-4o helps build environments but is not reported as the trajectory teacher.

Each row embeds JSON tool documents and Python source code that is executed locally in-process. The design avoids live external tool dependencies, but the implementation uses unrestricted exec and is not a security sandbox.

Programmatic/environmental feedback: execute the selected local Python function, test whether returned text contains one expected subanswer, update remaining subquestions, and apply the deterministic scalar reward. It verifies string-bearing environment progress, not semantic reasoning correctness.

Task completeness is reached when no subquestions remain; final-answer validity is checked separately by substring containment. The released sampler stops when the model emits no tool call or after 20 turns by default, and does not save the terminal no-tool response itself.

Manually authored question/answer and subquestion plan -> GPT-4o-assisted tool document/integration/scaling/ implementation -> released local environment row -> current-policy tool interaction -> executable feedback and updated unsolved set -> saved history state -> GRPO or Reinforce++ scalar-reward update.

A released raw row contains an initial user message with the question, serialized JSON tool schemas, serialized Python implementations, a mapping from tool names to still-unsolved golden subanswers, solve_rate, scenario source, split, and final reference answer. The paper reports 2,215 train and 200 custom in-domain test environments.

The sampler starts from the raw environment row, appends each assistant tool-calling response and its tool observations to messages, updates unsolved_set and solve_rate, and saves every resulting history state. The official repository does not include the generated trajectory files used for the paper runs.

For a response with p tool calls and q newly solved subquestions, R=2q/(p+1). A blank response receives -0.5, malformed tool markup -0.3, a response containing the reference answer 1/(1+t) for t remaining subquestions, a no-tool response after all subquestions are solved 0.5, and other responses 0. The reward manager places this scalar on the last valid response token.
GPT-4o assists environment construction; no separate teacher model is reported for policy trajectories.
GPT-4o generates/refines tool documents and Python implementations from manually created inputs; the current trainable policy then generates tool-use trajectories in those environments.
Manually created user inputs across four scenario structures. Exact source datasets, source documents, annotators, fact verification procedure, item identifiers, and source licenses are unknown.

The paper uses 16 rollouts per update and resamples trajectories from the current model at the start of each of three epochs. The released preprocessing recipe samples with temperature 1.0 and up to 20 turns before converting JSONL states to Parquet.
16 rollouts per update; total generated, retained, successful, and failed rollout counts are unknown.

GPT-4o environment construction uses temperature 0 and max_tokens 2048. The repository's data-sampling command uses temperature 1.0. The exact online RL decoding temperature for every paper run is unknown.
Multi-turn policy interaction over locally executed row-specific Python tools, followed by Parquet conversion and VeRL-based GRPO or Reinforce++ training.
unknown

The sampler defaults to 20 turns. Training maximum response length per step is 1,024 tokens for non-reasoning mode and 8,192 for reasoning mode; exact timeouts, retries, seeds, and total token/call budgets are unknown.

VeRL with GRPO or Reinforce++; learning rate 1e-6, train batch size 512, mini-batch size 32, 16 rollouts per update, KL loss coefficient 0.001, entropy coefficient 0.001, three paper-reported epochs with fresh trajectory resampling, and eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
